info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Create Meetings Meetings Schedule-v3-spec
info.description: The Meeting Scheduling API enables users to efficiently batch insert scheduled meetings within their calendar systems. This endpoint facilitates the creation of multiple meeting entries in a single operation, streamlining the planning process for users managing events or appointments. Typical consumers of this API include corporate event planners, scheduling software developers, and team collaboration tools looking to optimize meeting organization. By leveraging this API, applications can enhance user productivity and ensure that all scheduled meetings are seamlessly integrated into various calendar platforms.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to schedule a new meeting by providing necessary details such as time, participants, and topic. Ensure all required information is filled to successfully create the meeting entry in the system.

requestBody.description: Request body for scheduling a meeting. This should include all necessary details such as the meeting title, participants, date, time, and any specific agenda items. Ensure that the data is structured correctly as per the defined schema for successful processing.
